svg.title: Open proposals: two checks can stop one, an objection cannot, and all of them are kept
svg.desc: A proposal passes two checks that can stop it: facts, and feasibility. Each refusal is a recorded outcome. A strategy objection stays attached to the proposal and does not stop it. Published, refused and unpublished proposals all enter the method record. From that record, payoff and forecast score are read on two separate axes, and a frozen trial runs three arms forward from the same capital with missing marks left as holes. Nothing is promoted and no order is placed.

text.tspan: A different strategy can still be a valid proposal.
Code checks facts and authority. The model owns the hypothesis.
One proposal, two checks that can stop it
Every outcome enters the method record. A refused proposal still counts.
Read the record on two axes
A call can be right and lose money. The two are never merged.
Same capital and costs. A missing mark stays a hole.
Evidence for human review: no automatic method promotion, sizing or order placement.
